svg.title: Interactive six-state ceiling fan flipbook
svg.desc: Black-bladed, silver six-frame ceiling fan with two attached silver-chain pulls and black balls. Pull the fan cord to ramp from off to fastest or back to a stop. Pull the separate light cord or click the fixture to toggle its light.
svg.metadata: {"states":["off","very-slow","slow","medium","fast","fastest"],"rpm":[0,75,150,225,325,400],"control":"attached fan pull cord toggles off/full-speed","transition":"crossfade through adjacent embedded PNG frames to ramp from off to fastest and back"}

g.aria-label: Pull down to turn fan on or off
g.title: Pull the silver chain down to toggle the fan. The chain stays attached.

g.aria-label: Pull down to turn light on or off
g.title: Pull the silver chain down to toggle the light. The chain stays attached.
Click the light fixture to toggle its glow; its hit area is mapped in the companion GeoJSON.
